description.text: One of the two expansions that opened the Pokémon Card Game LEGEND series on 9 October 2009, made for the Nintendo DS games Pokémon HeartGold and SoulSilver, and released the same day as HeartGold Collection with Pokémon found only in it. Its headline is Lugia LEGEND, a legendary Pokémon made of two cards, drawn by the filmmaker Shinji Higuchi. Its Great Pokémon, called Pokémon Prime in English, are Meganium, Typhlosion, Crobat and Ursaring. Each pack held two holo cards, one of them a mirror holo, and a hidden Alph Lithograph written in Unown letters is numbered past its 70 cards. In English the two Collections were merged into HeartGold & SoulSilver, released on 10 February 2010.
